# Retained second-scale replay evidence

This directory preserves the independently checked second first-passage scale used by the native basin development. Its original sources, records, scripts, licenses, and notices remain unchanged.

For the current paper, follow [formal-basins-native](../../formal-basins-native/README.md) and then [formal-periodic-census](../../formal-periodic-census/README.md). To reproduce this earlier standalone replay, use `verify_replay.py` as documented in [REPLAY-REPORT.md](REPLAY-REPORT.md).

`local-replay-driver.py` is the historical driver retained with the original records. It imports the former repository-root `verify.py`, available in the September 2026 releases. It is not the current replay command.
